Investigation brief
A request, an archive, and a review trail

Trace how a request moves through the supplied AWS components, inspect service details, then record a local incident note. The topology is an illustrative fixture; it does not represent a live deployment.

Use the left navigation to move through the investigation. Select any node in the graph or service inventory to synchronize the detail inspector.
